title: Show a notification after unsafe disconnect of priorly mounted drives
line: Unplugging a USB stick or other removable drive while it is still mounted now shows a notification reminding you to safely remove it first.
explanation: When a removable drive disappeared while still mounted, the Disks & Devices applet just dropped it from the list: there was no feedback at all, so nothing taught users that unplugging without safely removing can lose data. The applet already knows the last mount state of each volume when Solid reports it gone. The change remembers in StateInfo whether a volume was still mounted when it was removed, and MessageInfo then sends a new "unsafelyRemoved" notification (its own event in devicenotifications.notifyrc, so it can be turned off in the notification settings) for volumes on removable drives.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: warn when a mounted device is unplugged

Unplugging a removable drive while it was still mounted went by without
any feedback, so users never learned that they could lose data. Now the
applet sends a notification asking them to safely remove devices first.

BUG: 396927

media.caption: Master: the mounted stick is unplugged and it silently disappears from Disks & Devices.
With the fix: a "Device Not Safely Removed" notification names the stick and asks to safely remove devices before unplugging.
Master: unplugging the mounted stick, no feedback.
With the fix: the notification appears as soon as the stick is unplugged.

reviews.text: The approach of tracking whether a volume was mounted at removal in StateInfo and emitting a configurable unsafelyRemoved notification in MessageInfo is clean and well-placed, but StateInfo::setNotPresentState has a logic bug that misses three of the most common unsafe-unplug scenarios. Because setNotPresentState still skips the transition whenever m_state is UnmountDone or Unmounting regardless of m_isMounted, no warning is shown if a user unplugs a drive after a failed unmount (e.g. DeviceBusy where m_state becomes UnmountDone while m_isMounted stays true), unplugs it mid-unmount (m_state == Unmounting), or unmounts via the applet and remounts externally before unplugging. Also, devicenotifications.notifyrc sets Sound=dialog-warning with Action=Popup (missing |Sound), which contradicts the notes claiming a warning sound.
changes: In StateInfo::setNotPresentState, allow transitioning to NotPresent and recording m_wasRemovedWhileMounted whenever m_isMounted is true (e.g. `if ((m_isMounted || (m_state != UnmountDone && m_state != Unmounting)) && m_storageInfo->device().udi() == udi)`), so unplugging after a failed unmount, during an in-progress unmount, or after an external remount still triggers the warning while preserving the safe-removal message after a successful unmount.

Align devicenotifications.notifyrc with the intended behavior for [Event/unsafelyRemoved]: either use `Action=Popup|Sound` if the warning sound should play by default, or drop the sound claim from the notes if popup-only is intended.
